get.summary: Searches for food items based on optional filters.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Supports pagination with page and perPage parameters.
If typeId is provided, only foods of that type are returned.
If name is provided, foods containing that text in their name are returned.

parameters.name: typeId
parameters.description: Optional food type ID to filter by.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional name to search for (partial match).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1).

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 10, max: 100).

200.description: Returns the list of matching food items.

post.description:
Requires admin role authentication. Either foodTypeId must be provided, or foodType.name must be specified
to create a new food type. The system will automatically handle food type creation if needed.

requestBody.description: The food data to create. Must include either foodTypeId or foodType.name.

200.description: Returns the created food item.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid food data or missing required fields.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific food item by its ID.
get.description: Requires user authentication. Returns detailed information about a single food item.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the food item.

200.description: Returns the requested food item.

404.description: Not Found - food item with the specified ID does not exist.

patch.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The food object must have its ID property set to match the route parameter.
Only non-null properties will be updated. Returns 400 if no fields are provided for update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the food item to update.

requestBody.description: The updated food data. The ID in the body must match the route parameter.

200.description: Returns the updated food item.

400.description: Bad Request - no valid fields provided for update or food item not found.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

delete.summary: Deletes a food item by its ID.
delete.description:
Requires admin role authentication. This operation is soft delete - the food item is marked as deleted
rather than being permanently removed from the database.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the food item to delete.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of food types with optional filtering and pagination.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Supports pagination with page and perPage parameters.
If name is provided, food types containing that text in their name are returned.
Results are sorted alphabetically by name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1).

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 25, max: 100).

200.description: Returns the list of matching food types.

post.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The food type name must be unique within the system.
Food type names are trimmed of whitespace and validated for minimum length.

requestBody.description: The food type data to create. Name is required and must be unique.

200.description: Returns the created food type.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid food type data or missing required fields.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific food type by its ID.
get.description: Requires user authentication. Returns detailed information about a single food type.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the food type.

200.description: Returns the requested food type.

404.description: Not Found - food type with the specified ID does not exist.

patch.description:
Requires admin role authentication. Only the name field can be updated.
The updated name must be unique within the system.
Returns 400 if no fields are provided for update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the food type to update.

requestBody.description: The updated food type data. Only provided fields will be updated.

200.description: Returns the updated food type.

400.description: Bad Request - no valid fields provided for update.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

404.description: Not Found - food type with the specified ID does not exist.

delete.summary: Deletes a food type by its ID.
delete.description:
Requires admin role authentication. This operation performs a cascading update:
- The food type is permanently removed from the database
- All foods that had this type will have their type_id set to null
- This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the food type to delete.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of ingredients with optional filtering and pagination.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Supports filtering by either recipeId or foodId, but not both simultaneously.
Each ingredient includes detailed information about the associated food item and measurement unit.
Results are sorted by ingredient ID in ascending order.

parameters.name: recipeId
parameters.description: Optional recipe ID to filter ingredients by recipe.

parameters.name: foodId
parameters.description: Optional food ID to filter ingredients by food item.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1).

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 25, max: 100).

200.description: Returns the list of matching ingredients.

post.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The ingredient links a specific food item to a recipe
with a specified quantity and unit of measurement. All referenced IDs (foodId, unitId, recipeId)
must exist in the database. The unitAmount must be a positive decimal value.

requestBody.description: The ingredient data to create. Must include valid foodId, unitId, unitAmount, and recipeId.

200.description: Returns the created ingredient.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid ingredient data or missing required fields.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific ingredient by its ID.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Returns complete ingredient information including
the associated food item and measurement unit details.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ingredient.

200.description: Returns the requested ingredient with full details.

404.description: Not Found - ingredient with the specified ID does not exist.

patch.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The ingredient object must have its ID property set to match the route parameter.
Only non-null properties will be updated. Returns 400 if no fields are provided for update.
All referenced IDs must remain valid after the update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the ingredient to update (must match the ingredient's ID in the request body).

requestBody.description: The updated ingredient data. The ID in the body must match the route parameter.

200.description: Returns the updated ingredient.

400.description: Bad Request - no valid fields provided for update or ingredient not found.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

delete.summary: Deletes an ingredient by its ID.
delete.description:
Requires admin role authentication. This operation permanently removes the ingredient from the database.
This breaks the link between the food item and recipe. The associated food item and recipe remain in the system.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ingredient to delete.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of meals with optional filtering and pagination.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Supports pagination with page and perPage parameters.
If name is provided, meals containing that text in their name are returned.
Results are sorted alphabetically by name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1).

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 25, max: 100).

200.description: Returns the list of matching meals.

post.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The meal name must be unique within the system.
Meal names are trimmed of whitespace and validated for minimum length.
Common meal types include Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack, but custom types are supported.

requestBody.description: The meal data to create. Name is required and must be unique.

200.description: Returns the created meal.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid meal data or missing required fields.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific meal by its ID.
get.description: Requires user authentication. Returns detailed information about a single meal.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the meal.

200.description: Returns the requested meal.

404.description: Not Found - meal with the specified ID does not exist.

patch.description:
Requires admin role authentication. Only the name field can be updated.
The updated name must be unique within the system.
Returns 400 if no fields are provided for update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the meal to update.

200.description: Returns the updated meal.

400.description: Bad Request - no valid fields provided for update or meal not found.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

delete.summary: Deletes a meal by its ID.
delete.description:
Requires admin role authentication. This operation performs a cascading update:
- The meal is permanently removed from the database
- All recipes that had this meal association will have their meal references removed
- This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the meal to delete.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of recipes with optional filtering and pagination.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Supports pagination with page and perPage parameters.
If name is provided, recipes containing that text in their name are returned.
Each recipe includes complete information about its ingredients, preparation steps, and meal associations.
Results are sorted by recipe ID in ascending order.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1).

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 25, max: 100).

200.description: Returns the list of matching recipes.

post.summary: Creates a new recipe with complete details.
post.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The recipe must include:
- Name (required, unique within the system)
- Preparation time in minutes (required, positive integer)
- Number of portions (required, positive integer)
- Complete ingredient list with valid food IDs, unit IDs, and quantities
- Step-by-step instructions in order
- Associated meal types
All referenced IDs must exist in the database.

requestBody.description: The recipe data to create including name, preparation time, portions, ingredients, steps, and meal associations.

200.description: Returns the created recipe.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid recipe data or missing required fields.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific recipe by its ID.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Returns complete recipe information including:
- Basic recipe details (name, preparation time, portions)
- Complete ingredient list with quantities and units
- Step-by-step preparation instructions
- Associated meal types

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the recipe.

200.description: Returns the requested recipe with full details.

404.description: Not Found - recipe with the specified ID does not exist.

patch.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The recipe object must have its ID property set to match the route parameter.
All recipe components can be updated including:
- Basic recipe details (name, preparation time, portions)
- Complete ingredient list (add, update, or remove ingredients)
- Preparation steps (add, update, or reorder steps)
- Meal associations (add or remove meal types)
Returns 400 if no fields are provided for update.
All referenced IDs must remain valid after the update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the recipe to update (must match the recipe's ID in the request body).

requestBody.description: The updated recipe data. The ID in the body must match the route parameter.

200.description: Returns the updated recipe.

400.description: Bad Request - no valid fields provided for update or recipe not found.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

delete.summary: Deletes a recipe by its ID.
delete.description:
Requires admin role authentication. This operation performs a cascading deletion:
- The recipe is permanently removed from the database
- All associated ingredients are removed
- All associated steps are removed
- All recipe-meal associations are removed
- All recipe-tag associations are removed
- All user meal records referencing this recipe remain but lose the recipe reference
This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the recipe to delete.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a selection of recipes for a specific meal type, excluding recipes used within a specified number of weeks.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. This endpoint is designed for meal planning to help users avoid recipe repetition.
The system looks back the specified number of weeks in the user's meal history and excludes any recipes
that have been used during that period. Returns up to 3 recipes (as defined by CHOOSE_SIZE constant)
that are associated with the specified meal type and haven't been used recently.
This helps with meal variety and planning.

parameters.name: mealId
parameters.description: The ID of the meal type for which recipes are needed (e.g., Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner).

parameters.name: excludeWeeks
parameters.description: Number of weeks to look back for used recipes to avoid repetition.

200.description: Returns a selection of recipes for the specified meal type.

404.description: Not Found - meal type with the specified ID does not exist.

get.summary: Retrieves recipe-meal associations with optional filtering.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Supports filtering by either recipeId or mealId, but not both simultaneously.
Each association includes the recipe ID, meal ID, and the full meal details.
Results are sorted by recipe ID in ascending order.

parameters.name: recipeId
parameters.description: Optional recipe ID to filter associations by recipe.

parameters.name: mealId
parameters.description: Optional meal ID to filter associations by meal type.

200.description: Returns the list of matching recipe-meal associations.

post.description:
Requires admin role authentication. Creates an association between a specific recipe and meal type.
Both recipeId and mealId must reference existing records in the database.
Duplicate associations (same recipe and meal combination) are not allowed.

requestBody.description: The recipe-meal association data to create. Must include valid recipeId and mealId.

200.description: Returns the created recipe-meal association.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid association data or missing required fields.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific recipe-meal association by its ID.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Returns complete information about the association
including the recipe ID, meal ID, and meal details.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the recipe-meal association.

200.description: Returns the requested recipe-meal association.

404.description: Not Found - recipe-meal association with the specified ID does not exist.

delete.summary: Deletes a recipe-meal association by its ID.
delete.description:
Requires admin role authentication. This operation removes the association between a recipe and meal type.
The recipe and meal records themselves remain in the database.
This is a safe operation that only removes the linking record.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the recipe-meal association to delete.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves recipe-tag associations with optional filtering.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Supports filtering by either recipeId or tagId, but not both simultaneously.
Each association includes the recipe ID, tag ID, and the full tag details.
Results are sorted by recipe ID in ascending order.

parameters.name: recipeId
parameters.description: Optional recipe ID to filter associations by recipe.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: Optional tag ID to filter associations by tag.

200.description: Returns the list of matching recipe-tag associations.

post.description:
Requires admin role authentication. Creates an association between a specific recipe and tag.
Both recipeId and tagId must reference existing records in the database.
Duplicate associations (same recipe and tag combination) are not allowed.

requestBody.description: The recipe-tag association data to create. Must include valid recipeId and tagId.

200.description: Returns the created recipe-tag association.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid association data or missing required fields.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

delete.summary: Deletes a recipe-tag association by recipe and tag IDs.
delete.description:
Requires admin role authentication. This operation removes the association between a recipe and tag.
The recipe and tag records themselves remain in the database.
This is a safe operation that only removes the linking record.

parameters.name: recipeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the recipe.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tag.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of steps with optional filtering and pagination.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Supports filtering by recipeId to get all steps for a specific recipe.
Steps are returned in sequential order by their stepNumber property.
Each step includes its instruction text and the recipe it belongs to.

parameters.name: recipeId
parameters.description: Optional recipe ID to filter steps by recipe.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1).

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 25, max: 100).

200.description: Returns the list of matching steps.

post.summary: Creates a new step for a recipe.
post.description:
Requires admin role authentication. Creates a new instruction step for a specific recipe.
The recipeId must reference an existing recipe. The stepNumber should be unique within the recipe
and represents the order in which this step should be performed. The instruction text should be
clear and detailed enough for users to follow.

requestBody.description: The step data to create. Must include recipeId, instruction text, and stepNumber.

200.description: Returns the created step.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid step data or missing required fields.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific step by its ID.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Returns detailed information about a single step
including its instruction text, step number, and associated recipe.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the step.

200.description: Returns the requested step.

404.description: Not Found - step with the specified ID does not exist.

patch.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The step object must have its ID property set to match the route parameter.
The instruction text, step number, and recipe association can be updated.
Returns 400 if no fields are provided for update.
All referenced IDs must remain valid after the update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the step to update (must match the step's ID in the request body).

requestBody.description: The updated step data. The ID in the body must match the route parameter.

200.description: Returns the updated step.

400.description: Bad Request - no valid fields provided for update or step not found.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

delete.summary: Deletes a step by its ID.
delete.description:
Requires admin role authentication. This operation permanently removes the step from the database.
The recipe itself remains in the system, but this specific instruction is lost.
Consider updating the step instead of deleting it if you want to preserve the recipe structure.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the step to delete.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of tags with optional filtering.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. If name is provided, tags containing that text in their name are returned.
Results are sorted alphabetically by name. Tags are used to categorize recipes for easier discovery.
Common tag examples include "vegetarian", "gluten-free", "quick-meal", "italian", etc.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive).

200.description: Returns the list of matching tags.

post.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The tag name must be unique within the system.
Tag names are trimmed of whitespace and validated for minimum length.
Tags help organize recipes by categories like dietary restrictions, cooking methods,
cuisine types, or any other meaningful classification system.

requestBody.description: The tag data to create. Name is required and must be unique.

200.description: Returns the created tag.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid tag data or missing required fields.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

200.description: OK

patch.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The tag object must have its ID property set to match the route parameter.
The updated name must be unique within the system. Returns 400 if no fields are provided for update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the tag to update (must match the tag's ID in the request body).

requestBody.description: The updated tag data. The ID in the body must match the route parameter.

200.description: Returns the updated tag.

400.description: Bad Request - no valid fields provided for update or tag not found.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

delete.summary: Deletes a tag by its ID.
delete.description:
Requires admin role authentication. This operation performs a cascading update:
- The tag is permanently removed from the database
- All recipe-tag associations for this tag are also removed
- Recipes themselves remain in the system, they just lose this tag classification
This is a safe operation that preserves recipe data while removing the categorization.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tag to delete.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Initializes a new instance of the FoodApp.Controllers.UnitController class.
get.description:
Requires user or admin authentication. Supports filtering by specific IDs or search text.
If both filters are provided, results must match both criteria.
Units are used to specify measurement quantities for recipe ingredients.
Common units include "cup", "gram", "tablespoon", "teaspoon", etc.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Optional array of unit IDs to filter by. If provided, only units with these IDs are returned.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional search text to filter units by name (partial match, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1).

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 25, max: 100).

200.description: Returns the list of matching units.

post.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The unit name must be unique within the system.
The volumeEquivalent is used for conversion calculations between different units.
For example, if 1 cup = 236.588 ml, then volumeEquivalent for cup would be 236.588.
This allows the system to convert between units for recipe scaling and ingredient calculations.

requestBody.description: The unit data to create. Must include name and volumeEquivalent.

200.description: Returns the created unit.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid unit data or missing required fields.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific unit by its ID.
get.description:
Requires user or admin authentication. Returns detailed information about a single unit
including its name, volume equivalent for conversion calculations, and description.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the unit.

200.description: Returns the requested unit.

404.description: Not Found - unit with the specified ID does not exist.

patch.description:
Requires admin role authentication. The updated name must be unique within the system.
The volumeEquivalent can be updated for conversion accuracy improvements.
Returns 400 if no fields are provided for update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the unit to update.

requestBody.description: The updated unit data. Only provided fields will be updated.

200.description: Returns the updated unit.

400.description: Bad Request - no valid fields provided for update or unit not found.

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

delete.summary: Deletes a measurement unit by its ID.
delete.description:
Requires admin role authentication. This operation performs a cascading update:
- The unit is permanently removed from the database
- All ingredients using this unit will have their unit_id set to null
- This is a destructive operation that affects recipe ingredients
Consider updating the unit instead of deleting it to preserve recipe integrity.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the unit to delete.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have admin role required for this operation.

get.summary: Converts an amount from one unit to another using volume equivalents.
get.description:
Requires user or admin authentication. This endpoint performs unit conversion based on
the volume equivalent values stored for each unit. The conversion uses the formula:
newAmount = (originalAmount * oldUnit.volumeEquivalent) / newUnit.volumeEquivalent
This is useful for recipe scaling, measurement system conversion, and ingredient calculations.

parameters.name: oldId
parameters.description: The ID of the unit to convert from.

parameters.name: newId
parameters.description: The ID of the unit to convert to.

parameters.name: originalAmount
parameters.description: The amount in the original unit to convert.

200.description: Returns the conversion result with new unit and amount.

404.description: Not Found - one or both unit IDs do not exist.

post.summary: Creates a new user account and returns an authentication token.
post.description:
Creates a new user account with the provided name, email, and password.
The password is securely hashed before storage. The email must be unique within the system.
Upon successful registration, a JWT authentication token is returned that can be used for subsequent API calls.
The token has a limited expiry time and should be refreshed using the /api/auth/me endpoint.

requestBody.description: The signup request containing user name, email, and password.

200.description: Returns the authentication token for the new user.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid signup data or missing required fields.

409.description: Conflict - a user with this email already exists.

post.summary: Authenticates a user and returns an authentication token.
post.description:
Authenticates the user with the provided email and password credentials.
The password is verified against the stored hash. Upon successful authentication,
a JWT token is returned that should be included in the Authorization header for subsequent requests.
The token includes the user's ID and has a limited expiry time.

requestBody.description: The login request containing email and password.

200.description: Returns the authentication token.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid login data or missing required fields.

get.summary: Retrieves the current user's profile information and refreshes the authentication token.
get.description:
Requires valid authentication token in the Authorization header. This endpoint serves multiple purposes:
1. Validates that the current token is still valid
2. Returns the current user's profile information including their role
3. Issues a new token with extended expiry time in the response headers
The new token should be stored by the client and used for subsequent API calls.
This endpoint is typically called when the client detects that the token is about to expire.

200.description: Returns the current user's profile with a refreshed token.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or expired authentication token.

404.description: Not Found - user account no longer exists.

get.summary: Retrieves the current user's meal records with optional date filtering.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Returns all meal records for the authenticated user within the specified date range.
If no date range is provided, returns all meal records for the user.
Each record includes the recipe details, meal type, and scheduled date.
This endpoint is useful for meal planning views and scheduling applications.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Optional start date to filter meal records (inclusive).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional end date to filter meal records (inclusive).

200.description: Returns the list of matching user meal records.

post.summary: Creates a new user meal record.
post.description:
Requires user authentication. Creates a new meal record for the authenticated user.
The userId is automatically set from the authentication token.
The recipeId must reference an existing recipe, and mealId must reference an existing meal type.
The mealDate specifies when the user plans to prepare this meal.
This endpoint is used for meal planning and scheduling functionality.

requestBody.description: The meal record data to create. Must include recipeId, mealId, and mealDate.

200.description: Returns the created user meal record.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid meal record data or missing required fields.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific user meal record by its ID.
get.description:
Requires user authentication. Returns detailed information about a specific meal record
including the associated recipe, meal type, and scheduled date.
Note that users can only access their own meal records.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user meal record.

200.description: Returns the requested user meal record.

404.description: Not Found - user meal record with the specified ID does not exist.

delete.summary: Deletes a user meal record by its ID.
delete.description:
Requires user authentication. This operation permanently removes the meal record from the user's schedule.
The associated recipe and meal type records remain in the system.
This is a safe operation that only removes the user's specific meal plan record.
Users can only delete their own meal records.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user meal record to delete.

200.description: Returns deletion status (true if successful, false if not found).

RecipeUpdateRequest.description:
mealIds and tagIds are treated as PUT, they are updated to be in state as in request
Ingredients are treated as inputs, they are added, nothing is removed
